# features

Feature families; each uses only what was known at the time.

| Module | What it does |
|---|---|
| [build.py](build.py) | Assemble the feature matrix across a universe, strictly per-instrument (Blueprint §2.2-2.3). |
| [cross_sectional.py](cross_sectional.py) | Cross-sectional features (Blueprint §2.7). |
| [delivery.py](delivery.py) | Delivery-% features (India-specific: fraction of traded volume actually delivered). |
| [events.py](events.py) | RAG -> ML fusion: late fusion of document-derived event features (Blueprint §4.8). |
| [fii_dii_features.py](fii_dii_features.py) | FII/DII flow features, scale-free: net flow (and its 5/20-day sums) in units of the series' own typical daily size (trailing 60-day mean absolute flow). |
| [fundamentals.py](fundamentals.py) | Fundamental feature engineering (Blueprint §2.4). |
| [macro_features.py](macro_features.py) | Macro features (Blueprint §2.5), scale-free only: 1/5/20-day log returns, log deviation from the 252-day mean (the level, detrended), and the 252-day rolling percentile. |
| [price_volume.py](price_volume.py) | Price/volume features (Blueprint §2.2): every value at row t uses data up to and including t only. |
| [regime.py](regime.py) | Rule-based market regime (Blueprint §3.8, the blueprint's own "acceptable design (a)"). |
| [regime_learned.py](regime_learned.py) | Learned market regime (Blueprint §3.8, the more complex of its two designs): a Gaussian mixture over a daily market-state vector, fit ONLY on training dates (fold-wise) so it cannot see the future. |
| [technical.py](technical.py) | Hand-implemented technical indicators (Blueprint §2.3) -- auditable formulas, backward-looking only. |
| [volatility.py](volatility.py) | Point-in-time features and targets for realised-volatility forecasting (HAR-RV family). |
| [volatility_events.py](volatility_events.py) | Scheduled board meetings. |
| [volatility_extra.py](volatility_extra.py) | Second-tier volatility features, all point-in-time and scale-free. |
| [volatility_global.py](volatility_global.py) | Overnight US market state and Nifty index volatility. |
| [volatility_intraday.py](volatility_intraday.py) | Realised-variance summaries from 1-minute bars (5-minute returns, regular session 09:15-15:30 IST). |
| [volatility_options.py](volatility_options.py) | Option-implied volatility from NSE's end-of-day F&O files. |
